apps.localizedDescription:
Nikcli:

Nikcli is a fork of OpenCode — the open source coding agent. AI-powered development tool: CLI, TUI, server, web, mobile, bots.

Nikcli is a fork of OpenCode, the open source coding agent (the repo previously lived at sst/opencode — same project, same org). All credit for the original project goes to the OpenCode authors and its community — nikcli exists only because that work is open source, and every part of nikcli that came from OpenCode remains theirs.
